page_title: TOR 1-0 COM | Torino v Como 25/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Giovanni Ayroldi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Como fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
90+6' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Ali Jasim (Como), pushing the ball around the post to safety. Como get a corner.
90+4' Substitution. Adam Masina makes way for Ali Dembele (Torino).
90+4' Maximo Perrone (Como) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
84' Matthias Braunoder (Como) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Substitution. Nico Paz is replaced by Luca Mazzitelli (Como).
83' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Alberto Moreno is replaced by Andrea Belotti (Como).
82' Here comes a substitution. Ali Jasim (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Alieu Fadera.
82' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Matthias Braunoder (Como) commits a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
75' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Alieu Njie (Torino), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
74' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
73' Nico Paz (Como) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
72' Substitution. Nikola Vlasic leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
72' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Nico Paz (Como) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the top right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punched it onto the post. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
71' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gabriel Strefezza (Como), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
71' Nico Paz (Como) works the corner short.

70' Patrick Cutrone (Como) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
70' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
70' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
65' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanabria (Torino) will be replaced by Alieu Njie.
65' A substitution has been made. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is replaced by Karol Linetty.
64' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) for his blatant foul.
64' The current number of corner kicks is 1:0.
63' Some great controlled play and passing from Como. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' It looks like Nico Paz (Como) saw red with that tackle. Giovanni Ayroldi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
57' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Emil Audero.
55' Che Adams (Torino) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
52' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
52' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Good work from Torino as they win a corner.
48' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
47' Samuele Ricci (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Che Adams (Torino) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Paolo Vanoli has made a change at the break. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) has come on in place of Sebastian Walukiewicz.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Maximo Perrone (Como) is penalised for a foul. Giovanni Ayroldi had a clear view and blows his whistle.

42' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Nico Paz (Como) is going to have a crack himself.
42' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
40' A goal, which was scored by Che Adams (Torino), was disallowed due to offside.
37' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matthias Braunoder (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Sergi Roberto can be given a rest.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' A cross into the box from Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is cleared.
32' The referee shows a yellow card to Karol Linetty (Torino). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
32' Adam Masina (Torino) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
30' Dangerous play by Karol Linetty (Torino). Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
28' Karol Linetty (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
27' Nico Paz (Como) tries to find Alieu Fadera, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

24' Alieu Fadera (Como) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
23' Samuele Ricci (Torino) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
22' Alieu Fadera (Como) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. Now Como have a corner.
20' Patrick Cutrone (Como) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
20' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
18' Nico Paz (Como) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
15' Some neat passing and movement from Como as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
11' Nico Paz (Como) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
6' Alberto Moreno (Como) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
3' Samuele Ricci (Torino) was too forceful with his tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Como are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' The first half has just begun.
Como will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
